useWhen: Configuring pricing tiers for new SaaS product
Designing launch discounts and special offers

workflow.description: Confirm pricing model, define tier structure, determine discount strategy
Set actual prices, create tier definitions, configure usage limits and features per tier
Design launch discount, define terms and conditions, set offer duration
Create pricing page content, write FAQ, prepare sales training materials

examples.input: Set pricing for our SaaS product launch next month
examples.output: Complete pricing strategy with tier configuration, launch offers, and documentation ready for go-live

examples.input: What launch discount should we offer?
examples.output: Recommended launch discount structure with terms, duration, and expected impact analysis
